headline: Marban Hollow Surges as Central Front Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Marban Hollow has erupted with sharp tactical shifts over the past two hours, logging seven base transitions as fighting flares around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Linn of Mercy continues its intense engagement with three further base turnovers and mounting casualties, particularly on the Warden line. Along the northern coast, Kuura Strand sustains active maneuvers around Talven and Faden Point, posting four strategic base actions within the two-hour window. Pressure remains steady in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, where localized base exchanges at The Wind Hills accompany substantial casualty totals. Meanwhile, pure attrition dominates Callahan's Passage and the Nevish Line, both enduring steep casualty rates despite a temporary pause in territory changes, while the southern reaches remain largely settled.
